title: Doug Greenig - At the Frontier of Trend Following

reader_summary.headline: Due to industry regulations, he will not discuss any of Newfound Research's funds on this podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Due to industry regulations, he will not discuss any of Newfound Research's funds on this podcast. My guest in this episode is Doug Greenig, CEO and CIO of Florencourt Capital. Flore and court specializes in delivering an alternative market CTA, trading over 500 markets ranging from Turkish cross-currency swaps to French power.

key_points.text: Doug also explains why he thinks these markets tend to behave better than traditional markets.
key_points.evidence_quote: Doug also explains why he thinks these markets tend to behave better than traditional markets, why you don't need special trend signals to trade them, and the significant diversification potential they can introduce.

thesis: The speaker outlines his career progression from fixed income and macro trading to cross-sectional systematic macro and finally to time series macro trend following. He emphasizes that trend following works because volatility tends to burst when trends die or reverse, and he notes the importance of being suspicious of data due to non-stationarity in the world.
